Oracle layoffs: More job cuts expected as company faces rising AI data centre costs

Oracle is increasing the estimated cost of its 2026 restructuring plan to $2.8 billion as it cuts jobs while spending heavily on AI data centres. The company has already booked $2.1 billion in restructuring costs, with another $700 million expected as further workforce reductions are planned.

External source Firstpost 12 Sept 2026, 3:19 pm 1 min brief
